# Test fixtures

Fixtures are synthetic only. They contain no real infrastructure data. Values use obvious
markers such as `SYNTHETIC-...`.

Golden files (in `pkg/report/testdata/`) are refreshed only with `go test ./pkg/report -update`,
and every diff must be reviewed against `specs/001-baseline-cli-behavior/contracts/cli-contract.md`.

## Terraform version

The hand-written fixtures in `plans/` use `terraform_version` `1.17.2`, the newest stable release listed on
https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/ (checked 2026-11-25).

Supported series could not be confirmed from HashiCorp's official source: the support-policy
page (`developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/docs/support-period-and-end-of-life-policy`)
returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-25. The releases index lists the series 1.17, 1.16, 1.15, 1.14,
1.13, 1.12, 1.11, 1.10 and 1.9 (latest patches 1.17.2, 1.16.7, 1.15.9, 1.14.9, 1.13.5, 1.12.2,
1.11.4, 1.10.5, 1.9.8) but does not state which are supported. The choice of 1.17.2 was
confirmed by the maintainer.

The authentic plans in `plans/terraform/` carry the version of the Terraform binary that generated
them (see below), because they are the verbatim output of `terraform show -json`.

## Plans

| Fixture | terraform_version | format_version | purpose |
|---------|-------------------|----------------|---------|
| `plans/basic.json` | 1.17.2 | 1.2 | 4 changes: 1 add, 1 change, 1 destroy, 1 replace |
| `plans/modules-and-counts.json` | 1.17.2 | 1.2 | module paths and indexes (Known Gap: not shown in reports) |
| `plans/noop-and-read.json` | 1.17.2 | 1.2 | 1 counted change plus no-op, read and empty-actions entries |
| `plans/sensitive.json` | 1.17.2 | 1.2 | marker strings that must never appear in any report |
| `plans/no-changes.json` | 1.17.2 | 1.2 | valid plan with empty `resource_changes` |
| `plans/unknown-action.json` | 1.17.2 | 1.2 | one valid change and one unknown action |
| `plans/real-shape.json` | 1.17.2 | 1.2 | exact Terraform export shape (boolean sensitivity flags, scalar output); Known Gap: rejected by the parser |
| `plans/empty-object.json` | none | none | `{}`: valid plan without changes or version |
| `plans/invalid.json` | none | none | not JSON, must fail to parse |
| `plans/multi-provider.json` | 1.17.2 | 1.2 | 9 counted changes over AWS, Azure, Google, Kubernetes, Datadog and Cloudflare, one no-op; the name `main` is reused across types |
| `plans/legacy-format.json` | 0.12.31 | 0.1 | older plan format, without `after_unknown` and sensitivity fields |

## Authentic plans

`plans/terraform/*.json` are real `terraform show -json` outputs, generated by `scripts/gen-plans.sh`
(`make fixtures`) from the scenarios in `scenarios/<name>/`. They need only `terraform` and `jq`: the
scenarios use the built-in `terraform_data` resource, so there is no provider download, network access
or credential. The script removes the non-deterministic `timestamp` and replaces generated UUIDs with a
fixed value, so regenerating with the same Terraform version gives the same files.

A scenario holds `plan/` (the configuration that is planned), optionally `base/` (applied first to build
a prior state), `flags` (extra `terraform plan` flags) and `taint` (addresses tainted after the base
apply). Generated with Terraform 1.10.5.

| Scenario | counted changes | purpose |
|----------|-----------------|---------|
| `mixed-actions` | add 1, change 1, destroy 1, replace 1, 1 ignored | every action in one plan, with an output change and `delete_because_no_resource_config` |
| `create-before-destroy` | replace 1 | replacement ordered `["create","delete"]` |
| `forced-replace` | replace 2, 1 ignored | `replace_by_request` (`-replace`) and `replace_because_tainted` |
| `destroy-all` | destroy 3 | `terraform plan -destroy` |
| `moved` | change 1, 1 ignored | `moved` blocks: `previous_address`, a move with a change and a pure move |
| `import` | change 1 | `import` block, `importing` in the change |
| `count-for-each` | add 8 | `count` indexes and `for_each` keys with spaces, quotes and non-ASCII characters |
| `nested-modules` | add 7 | nested modules, `count` and `for_each` on modules |
| `sensitive` | add 1 | sensitive variable and output |
| `data-source` | add 1, 1 ignored | data source deferred to apply (`mode: data`, action `read`) |
| `no-changes` | none, 2 ignored | all resources up to date (`no-op`) |
| `empty-config` | none | configuration without a resource: `resource_changes` is absent |

Known Gap: every plan that creates or deletes a resource carries `before_sensitive: false` or
`after_sensitive: false`, which the parser rejects today (see `real-shape.json`). Those plans are pinned
by provisional tests, and their counting logic is still verified once the unreadable flags are removed.
The tests also list every file of this directory, so a new scenario must be classified.

## Volume

No large file is committed. `pkg/report/scale_test.go` builds a 5 000-change plan in memory (seven
resource types, names with spaces, quotes and non-ASCII characters, every action including no-op, read
and empty) and checks counts, ordering and determinism. `go test ./pkg/report -bench FormatLargePlan`
measures 10 000 changes.

## Examples

`examples/` at the repository root holds plans only, as a copy of fixtures that the tool can read. The
test in `cmd/tf2report/examples_test.go` keeps them in sync with this directory.
